0022600191.text: The Knicks (4-4) visit the Cavaliers (4-4) for their ninth game of the 2026-27 season, with New York 7th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, on a two-game winning streak, while Cleveland, 6th in the East, is on a two-game losing streak. Josh Hart is out for New York with an ankle injury, and Jaylon Tyson is out for Cleveland with an ankle sprain. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks won 2-1 in the 2025-26 season and 4-0 in the 2025-26 playoffs, and their most recent meeting was a 130-93 Knicks win in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
